header.title: MCP Access
header.subtitle: Generate a personal token to connect your own MCP client (e.g. Claude Desktop) to your ArbiScanner spread data.

token.label: Your MCP token
token.warning: This token acts like a password for your account's spread data — anyone who has it can read your open spreads through the MCP server. It does not expire on a fixed schedule, and generating a new one does not invalidate the old one, so store it somewhere you can find and delete later if needed.

instructions.title: How to use it
instructions.step2: In your MCP client's settings, add a new remote MCP server pointing at:
instructions.step4: Once connected, ask your assistant things like "what arbitrage spreads are currently open?" or "give me the details of spread <id>" — it will call ArbiScanner's tools on your behalf, scoped to your own account.
